prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one original opaque seamless material texture for a small-camera top-down Mediterranean/medieval city game, not a scene or building illustration. Primary request: a square, straight-on diffuse albedo material master of quiet cool pale limestone limewash/plaster for an official masonry wall and compact watch pavilion. Fill the ENTIRE square canvas edge to edge with the material, ideally about 1024 x 1024. Material: subdued neutral cool ivory/light gray, very subtle broad limewash value variation, fine restrained mineral grain, a few soft sparse aged plaster patches that remain quiet when displayed 112 to 192 pixels high. No repeated rows of bricks or outlined stone courses. No architectural edges, plinth, border, framed panel, corner, windows, doors, arches, props, foliage, writing, emblems or symbols. Lighting: flat neutral diffuse material capture, no directional cast shadow, no dramatic vignette, no painted highlight or light source. The game supplies geometry corners, eave/contact shadows, base treatment and sunlight. Seamlessly tileable in both axes with matching edge character; no obvious edge seam or repeated landmark. Style: painterly realistic hand-finished game texture, broad believable weathered pale wall surface; temperate European city, not sand/desert/beige, not shiny plastic, not dark grunge. Strong constraints: absolutely no magic seals, circles, runes, glow, ritual machinery, breaches, pipes or ornamental pattern. One single material sheet, no collage, no alternate swatches, no text, no scene background. Opaque background/material everywhere.
acceptance: Original inspected: quiet neutral material with restrained mottled plaster/limestone variation. Seamless use is intent, not a mathematical equal-border claim. Native integration review required.
